errors.artifact_not_of_run: file {id} does not belong to this run
errors.base_url_invalid: the base URL must be an absolute http or https address
errors.base_url_userinfo: the base URL must not carry a user or password; use test logins instead
errors.branch_invalid: {branch} is not a valid branch name
errors.branch_sandbox_only: only a Sandbox runs a branch; other environments run what is deployed
errors.case_not_on_env: {keys} cannot run on {env}: a case of one project runs on that project's environments only
errors.delete_on_project: this environment belongs to a project: delete it from the project page
errors.env_busy: a batch is still running on this environment; cancel it or wait for it to finish
errors.env_name_taken: there is already an environment called {name}
errors.env_name_too_long: the environment name can have at most {max} characters
errors.env_no_url: {env} has no URL yet: add one before running cases on it
errors.field_not_editable: {field} cannot be changed on a {kind} environment
errors.link_not_standalone: only an environment with no project can be linked to a project environment
errors.link_target_has_runs: that project environment already has runs in Evidence: it cannot take another environment's place
errors.no_recording: there is no open recording in this chat
errors.nothing_to_run: no recorded case matches: record a case with an agent or upload its take first
errors.projects_unavailable: projects are not available on this instance
errors.sandbox_fixed: a project's Sandbox comes and goes with the project
errors.secret_name_invalid: {name} is not a valid name: use capital letters, digits and _ (for example TEST_PASSWORD)
errors.secret_too_long: the value of {name} is too long
errors.tag_too_long: a tag can have at most {max} characters
errors.take_base_url: the take has no valid base URL
errors.take_not_json: the take is not valid JSON
errors.take_too_large: the take is larger than {max} bytes
errors.title_too_long: the title can have at most {max} characters
errors.too_many_secrets: an environment can have at most {max} test logins
errors.too_many_tags: a case can have at most {max} tags

log.deploy_failed: queue evidence after a deploy on environment {env}
log.ensure_rows_failed: give project environments their evidence rows
log.launch_failed: start the evidence runner of batch {batch}
log.mark_failed: record the schedule run of environment {env}
log.revoke_failed: revoke the runner key of batch {batch}
log.sandbox_mark_failed: record the sandbox progress of batch {batch}
log.sandbox_reaped: remove evidence sandbox {owner} left by the previous run of the daemon
log.undo_failed: delete project environment {env} after its evidence row failed

reasons.daemon_restarted: Thulu restarted while this batch ran
reasons.runner_lost: the runner stopped before this run finished
reasons.sandbox_branch_not_found: the branch {branch} does not exist in the repository
reasons.sandbox_launch_failed: the sandbox could not be created, so the init script never ran
reasons.sandbox_no_init_script: the project has no init script
reasons.sandbox_no_preview_port: none of the init script's ports is one a sandbox exposes
reasons.sandbox_params_missing: the init script needs {names} and has no default for it
reasons.sandbox_no_room: no sandbox was free for 20 minutes
reasons.sandbox_ready_timeout: the app did not answer in time
reasons.sandbox_source_failed: the branch could not be copied into the sandbox
reasons.sandbox_start_failed: the init script exited with code {code}
reasons.sandbox_tools_failed: the init script's tools could not be installed
reasons.sandbox_unreachable: the runner could not open the URL: {error}
